evidence: Fresh V42.36 diagnostics selected src-tauri/src/models/tool.rs and src-tauri/src/tools.rs from 75 Cargo errors.
No Rust source change was accepted after selection.
The 9B repair call exceeded its two-minute watchdog and the 27B rescue exceeded four minutes.
Same-revision loop hygiene then blocked inherited fallback attempts.
The last accepted source progress remained the earlier TypeScript diagnostic reduction from 8 to 0.
A Vite package-shadow alias failure was misclassified as validator infrastructure.

root_causes_fixed: Candidate replay could validate the first non-Python component instead of the exact failing component.
Model transport timeouts were allowed to consume/poison semantic repair convergence.
Long inherited repair watchdogs made a no-output cycle take minutes before fallback.
A successful bundler launch followed by an imported-file ENOENT was classified as missing-tool infrastructure.
V42.37 initially bypassed V42.36 component-aware stale-blocker invalidation; the compatibility suite found and the release fixes this regression.
Known provider-token passthrough was removed before the explicit private-dependency allowlist could apply.
host_limitations: The validation host did not provide Cargo/Rust or the user's local Qwen endpoints, so the exact Windows GearTrack binary and live model inference were not executed here.
Captured compiler/model failures were reproduced with deterministic component, transaction, timeout, and sandbox fixtures.
